description.value: Mary Brown's is a 100% Canadian-owned fast food chain specializing in fresh, hand-cut and hand-breaded chicken and hand-cut potato Taters, with roots going back to St. John's, Newfoundland in 1969. This Langley location is one of nearly 300 locations across Canada, offering takeout service. Cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor may find it a convenient calorie stop on longer routes.
